Definition: to locate, i.e. (generally) hang on or (figuratively) establish, reduce
BiblicalUsage: To set on a pot and to ordain peace are the same word in Hebrew, because both are a placing that holds. Elisha said, set on the great pot, when the sons of the prophets were hungry in a dearth, and Isaiah says the LORD will ordain peace for us, for He has wrought all our works in us. The psalm carries the hardest use, where the sufferer is brought into the dust of death.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God ordains peace for us, and the pot Elisha set on is the proof that He feeds His people in a dearth.
